WHAT T-1636 FOUND: T-1629 filled the slough mouth this project had cut west of State Street and 91 flat positions appeared; 81 of them stood in the fort road, which plat_corridors cannot see because that road was never platted, so `fits` counted the 10 clear of it and `fits_in_an_unplatted_track` held the 81 the road took. WHAT T-1637 CHANGED, AND IT IS THE ROAD AND NOT THE GROUND: the fort road crossed the slough's new mouth in open water with no crossing recorded and none evidenced, so its western terminus moved onto State Street at the toe of the Slough Log Bridge's southern approach and its reach across this strip is gone. The road now takes NOTHING here (`fits_in_an_unplatted_track` is 0 at every clause, against 81), and the 81 positions it held are released to `fits`: 91, 96, 162, 233. Not one square metre of ground moved. THE PLATE'S OWN FRONTAGE IS UNTOUCHED AND THAT IS THE FINDING THAT MATTERS: `fits_beside_the_street` is 0, 0, 0, 3 - the same figures T-1636 banked, still zero at every relief clause west of South Water Street's committed east end, which is the frontage image 3 draws warehouses on. T-0134's refusal therefore stands. What is genuinely re-opened is the UNPLATTED ground between that end (E +805) and the Reservation's west line (E +842) - reservation ground, not town frontage, and whether anything of the plate belongs on it is its own question, filed rather than answered here.
